title: I1: Reproduce the incumbent and gate decoder control during rolling
hypothesis: During the incumbent's rolling stroke, small bounded contact-frame joint increments added to the incumbent's action produce directionally reliable relative fingertip motion (paired + / - contrast). This is about directional tracking only; retention under a nonzero pulse is reported per cell and is not claimed.

prediction.rationale: Rank 1: this gate can prevent all downstream contact-controller spending; gate_statistics.pooled_paired_sign_agreement must reach 0.80, an absolute increase of 0.30 over chance.

code_changes: Module lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/rolling_decoder_gate.py, config block rolling_decoder_gate (with rolling_baseline and rolling_decoder_calibration merged from it) in config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml, three registry names in scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py. Stage 3, unchanged config/pen_spin/d058_fixed_stroke_incumbent, one whole 80-case manifest per fresh Isaac process, serial on the box, no LLM, no retries.

Order of execution, three separate commands. (S1) `python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --study rolling_baseline`: the incumbent alone on the seed-4741 gate manifest, 80 episodes, a stop point. (CAL) `--study rolling_decoder_calibration` on seed 4740: 5 settings x 2 signs x 80 = 800 episodes. (S2) `--study rolling_decoder_gate` on seed 4741: the zero-request residual plus 30 directional cells = 31 x 80 = 2,480 episodes; the incumbent-alone cell is S1's and is not rerun. Total 3,360.

S1 report and stop rule: sustained success with its Wilson 95% interval; S1 reproduces if that interval overlaps the recorded band [0.35, 0.44] (a point estimate inside the band is too strict at n=80, SE about 0.055). Also: drops / off-centre / slow-spin split, tail-hit fraction, and per outcome the median of pre-window |axial rate|, direction-aligned integrated roll after step 150, integral |axial rate| and sign reversals of the 15-step smoothed rate, where each case's roll direction is the sign of its median axial rate over steps 120-149 (causal). The S1 report is returned to the advisor (consult) for agreement before the calibration or any pulse cell runs; if S1 does not reproduce, nothing else runs and the idea is recorded as stopped at S1.

The calibration grid is committed in the config before S1 runs and never edited afterwards: decoder base {damping 1e-4, max_joint_speed 6.0, lookahead 0.1 s, joint_limit_margin 0.02, max_request_speed 0.05}; five (damping, per-joint increment cap in rad) settings (1e-4, 0.15), (1e-4, 0.30), (1e-3, 0.15), (1e-3, 0.30), (1e-2, 0.30). Case i pulses fingertip-axis contrast i mod 15, + in one cell and - in the other. Selection (rolling_decoder_gate.select_setting) reads calibration seed 4740 only and never sustained success or S1: among settings with bound activity <= 0.20 and median feasible/requested >= 0.70 (all settings if none qualifies), the highest pooled paired sign agreement with values within 0.02 tied, then the lowest median tracking error, then the lowest bound activity, then the lowest index. The chosen decoder and controller constants, the windows, thresholds and eligibility rule are hashed into frozen_sha256 in the config before any residual cell on seed 4741; the gate refuses to run on a hash mismatch or if S1 did not reproduce.

Residual (trusted code, RollingPulseController): for control steps 150 <= t < 180 the commanded fingertip's 0.02 m/s request in capsule [normal, circumferential, axial] coordinates is decoded (contact_control.decode, damped least squares, target = R u alone, no pen following, wrist held, only the commanded finger's chain) into joint speeds; the joint offset INTEGRATES inside the window (delta += dt * qdot, each joint |delta| <= cap) because the incumbent's action is q + 0.8 (target - q) and a non-accumulating offset would give a position step, not a velocity; action = clamp(incumbent + normalised(delta + lookahead * qdot), -1, 1). Outside the window delta is zero and the action is the incumbent's bit for bit; the incumbent's own stroke state is never touched. The zero-request residual runs the same decoder with nothing commanded and must equal the incumbent's action exactly (max abs difference 0.0, recorded).

Three motions, each as half the positive-minus-negative paired contrast of the same case: requested u; feasible = the decoded joint speed after the speed, joint-limit and cap bounds mapped through the Jacobian (local frame); achieved = the link-origin-corrected fingertip velocity minus the pen's rigid velocity at the nearest surface point, averaged over observations 151..180 and projected on the frame at step 150. Reported per pair: gain d = achieved/requested along the commanded axis, feasible/requested, normalised tracking error |achieved - feasible| / |feasible|, fraction of pulse steps with any bound (speed, joint limit, cap, action clamp) active on the commanded chain.

Eligibility reads only the common pre-pulse prefix: the pen has not fallen by step 150 and the median |axial rate| over steps 120-149 is at least 1 rad/s. Every pre-pulse-eligible case stays in its assigned contrast after the pulse; pulse-induced drops and tracking failures are reported, never excluded (a pair with no post-pulse step scores d = 0, a disagreement).

Gate verdict (S2), all thresholds declared now: Jacobian audit median error < 0.15; zero-request residual timeout rate minus incumbent timeout rate >= -0.10; zero-request identity exactly 0; observations of every pulse cell equal its partner's and the incumbent's up to step 150 (otherwise the pairing is void and the gate is inconclusive); all 15 contrasts with >= 20 eligible pairs (otherwise inconclusive); pooled paired sign agreement >= 0.80; every contrast's sign agreement >= 0.70; median paired gain in [0.30, 1.50]; median feasible/requested >= 0.70; bound activity <= 0.20 of pulse steps; median normalised tracking error <= 0.70. A failed Jacobian audit, retention or identity check fails the gate; otherwise inconclusive coverage/pairing; otherwise pass only if every tracking check holds.

Uncertainty: the pooled sign agreement is reported with a case-clustered 95% interval (percentile bootstrap resampling cases, 2000 resamples, seed 0), since the 15 contrasts share cases. Pulse-cell retention (timeout rate per directional cell, pulse-window drops) is reported separately and not treated as established by the zero-request check.

No automatic recalibration, retry, LLM, BC, RL, curriculum or gradient fitting after gate outcomes. Mocked unittest tests/test_rolling_decoder_gate.py (paired statistics, verdict precedence, selection rule, zero-request identity with a fake context).

falsified_by: The directional-control prediction is refuted if the case-clustered 95% interval of the pooled paired sign agreement has its upper bound below 0.80; an interval spanning 0.80 is inconclusive. Operational qualification of the decoder additionally requires every declared gate check (rolling_decoder_gate.gate_verdict == pass), regardless of the prediction verdict.

controls.gate0: adopt_fixed_stroke.py passes; replay of logs/pen_spin/r081_stroke_feedback fresh manifest bit-identical (35/80)

result.notes: Episodes: S1 80 + calibration 800 + gate 2,480 = 3,360 (plus 80 gate-0 replay, not evidence); 0 LLM generation calls; wall time about 35 minutes on the box. Deviation, made after the calibration and before any gate cell: the prefix-identity check originally compared every recorded step up to 150, including steps after a case had ended (the next episode's auto-reset), and reported differences of 11-24; restricted to in-play steps the prefixes are bit-identical between processes (0.0), and the gate used the in-play check. It did not enter the calibration's selection. No calibration setting met bound activity <= 0.20 and feasible/requested >= 0.70, so the declared fallback chose cal2 by sign agreement (0.783; cal2 and cal3 identical). Post hoc, not pre-declared, from the recorded gate traces: (1) the split is by finger. Forefinger and ring finger track (sign agreement 0.994 and 1.000, bound activity 0.05 and 0.14, gains 0.21-0.92); middle finger and thumb do not (0.411 and 0.315), little finger is mostly bounded (0.899, bound activity 0.71). (2) The incumbent's own action is saturated at +/-1 on MFJ2 on 79% and LFJ1 on 64% (LFJ3 32%) of pulse-window steps, so an additive increment there is clipped; thumb-chain bounds are active on 0.89-0.98 of steps. (3) For mf_circumferential the pen surface point moves with the request (+0.52 of the requested speed) more than the fingertip does (+0.20), so the relative motion is opposite: that finger carries the pen. (4) Pulses changed no episode length: every pulse cell has the incumbent's 8 early drops and timeout rate 0.90, sustained successes 25-30 against 28. Unmeasured: contact forces; which individual bound was active (the trace stores their union); any request other than 0.02 m/s for 0.5 s at steps 150-180.

verdicts.reasoning: Against the recorded 0.50 chance control, gate_statistics increased by 0.22381, short of the predicted 0.30 [logs/pen_spin/r097_rolling_decoder_gate/gate_summary.json]. Pooled paired sign agreement was 0.72381 with case-clustered 95% interval [0.70952, 0.73929], whose upper bound is below 0.80, meeting the predeclared falsification condition [logs/pen_spin/r097_rolling_decoder_gate/gate_summary.json]. Coverage, in-play prefix identity, zero-request identity, retention and Jacobian checks passed, so the declared pairing and coverage rules do not make this inconclusive [logs/pen_spin/r097_rolling_decoder_gate/gate_summary.json]. Operational qualification also failed: feasible/requested was 0.44487 against a 0.70 minimum, bound activity was 0.43984 against a 0.20 maximum, tracking error was 0.84009 against a 0.70 maximum, and the weakest contrast's sign agreement was 0.03571 against a 0.70 minimum [logs/pen_spin/r097_rolling_decoder_gate/gate_summary.json]. These results refute the claimed directional reliability of this frozen rolling decoder, not contact coordinates generally [logs/pen_spin/r097_rolling_decoder_gate/gate_summary.json].

(Written before the advisor's analysis; its first submission was refused on a malformed --confidence value and the chained analyse call ran, so the ledger order is advisor-then-implementer. The text is unchanged.) The registered prediction (pooled paired sign agreement >= 0.80, i.e. +0.30 over chance) is refuted by its own rule: 0.724 over 840 eligible pairs, case-clustered 95% interval [0.710, 0.739], upper bound below 0.80. The operational gate FAILS on five of six tracking checks (weakest contrast 0.036, feasible/requested 0.445 < 0.70, bound activity 0.44 > 0.20, tracking error 0.84 > 0.70); only the pooled gain 0.34 is in range. Every instrument check passes (Jacobian audit 0.0025, zero-request identity 0.0, in-play prefix identity 0.0, coverage 56 pairs per contrast, S1 reproduced at 28/80), so this is a measured failure of the decoder as an additive residual on this incumbent, not an instrument failure. Scope: this decoder (frozen cal2), a 0.02 m/s pulse at steps 150-180, this incumbent. It does not say contact coordinates cannot help; post hoc the forefinger and ring finger track almost perfectly, and the failures sit where the incumbent's own action is already saturated (MFJ2 79%, LFJ1 64%) or the thumb chain is bounded.
verdicts.next_experiment: Do not run the contact arm of R-099. Re-triage R-099 as its declared anonymous-only fallback against the incumbent (2,180 episodes), which needs no decoder. If contact coordinates are pursued later: restrict to the two fingers that track (ff, rf), or give the residual authority over the incumbent's saturated targets rather than adding to a clipped action.

direction: No LLM calls in any protocol. Test bounded residual repairs of the working fixed-stroke incumbent (config/pen_spin/d058_fixed_stroke_incumbent) on Stage 3, in four separately gated steps: (S1) reproduce the incumbent on fixed cases and quantify its slow-spin failures, with angular progress measured along each case's own roll direction; (S2) qualify the contact-frame decoder DURING ROLLING on top of the incumbent stroke, reporting requested, feasible (after bounds and least squares) and achieved motion separately, with tracking error, directional agreement and bound activity as pass/fail criteria (controllability gate); (S3) only if S2 passes, compare incumbent alone, a hand-authored contact-frame residual and a hand-authored anonymous-coordinate joint residual, with matched tuning budgets (same parameter count, same number of probe evaluations, same tuning method, tuned on probe cases and frozen before any fresh case), candidates ranked by tail-hit fraction with sustained unsigned angular progress and retention inspected; (S4) evaluate the selected controllers on fresh paired cases, 90 pairs per comparison, Holm correction over the two comparisons, promotion requires the strict paired sustained-success rule AND a pre-declared numeric non-inferiority bound on drops (usefulness gate). Residuals must not assume a roll sign. If S2 fails, the anonymous residual may still be compared against the incumbent alone. A failed hand-authored controller shelves that decoder/controller family only. No BC, RL, curriculum or gradient fitting. One protocol at a time on the box.

advisor.reasoning: Qualification during the incumbent's rolling stroke addresses the regime mismatch that the settled-posture decoder results left unresolved. However, the prerequisite calibration currently spends 800 episodes before S1 reproduces the incumbent, contrary to the separately gated sequence. The maximum 3,360-episode, zero-LLM budget is acceptable only with an initial 80-episode S1 stop point.
suggested_changes: Reuse scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py and config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml to execute the existing 80-case incumbent-alone cell as a standalone S1 first, using seed 4741. Return its reproduction, slow-spin, direction-aligned progress and retention report for separate agreement before executing calibration or decoder pulses; do not rerun that baseline. Remaining S2 budget is at most 3,280 episodes, with zero LLM calls throughout.

Freeze the calibration tuple grid before S1. Select decoder constants exclusively from calibration seed 4740, never from S1 outcomes, and hash the selected constants before accessing any residual-cell outcomes on seed 4741.

Predeclare case-clustered uncertainty intervals for pooled sign agreement, since the 15 contrasts share cases. Keep every pre-pulse-eligible case in its assigned contrast after the pulse; report pulse-induced drops and tracking failures rather than excluding them.

Narrow the hypothesis to reliable directional tracking during rolling: the zero-pulse retention check does not establish retention under nonzero pulses. Report pulse-cell retention separately without treating it as already established.

Retain the prediction: gate_statistics increases by at least 0.30 against the 0.50 sign-balanced chance control, corresponding to pooled agreement of 0.80. Retain falsified_by: an agreement interval upper bound below 0.80 refutes the predicted magnitude; an interval spanning 0.80 is inconclusive, and operational qualification still requires every declared gate.

implementer.reasoning: Agree to revise, and agree with every advisor change (S1 first as an 80-episode stop point on seed 4741, grid frozen before S1, case-clustered interval for pooled agreement, no post-pulse exclusion, hypothesis narrowed to directional tracking). Two further changes of mine: (a) the S1 pass rule 'point estimate in [0.35, 0.44]' is too narrow at n=80 (SE about 0.055, so a correctly reproduced incumbent fails it about half the time); use 'the 95% interval of the sustained-success estimate overlaps [0.35, 0.44]' and report the estimate. (b) The residual must be stated precisely: the incumbent's action is q + 0.8*(target - q), so a per-step non-accumulating joint offset yields a position step, not a velocity. The pulse offset must integrate the decoded joint velocity inside the pulse window (delta += dt*qdot per step, each joint's |delta| bounded by the frozen cap B, released to zero after the window), never touching the incumbent's own stroke state; achieved motion is then the mean relative fingertip velocity over the window.

advisor.reasoning: Rolling qualification addresses the regime mismatch left open by the settled-posture gates; the budget is at most 3,360 episodes and zero LLM calls, with a mandatory 80-episode S1 stop. I accept both implementer arguments: Wilson overlap is a reasonable compatibility screen at n=80, and integrating the bounded offset tests velocity tracking rather than a position step. The weakest point remains scope: paired pulse tracking and zero-request identity do not establish retention under nonzero residuals or sustained-success usefulness. Retain the gate_statistics prediction of an increase of at least 0.30 over 0.50 chance agreement; a case-clustered 95% agreement interval entirely below 0.80 falsifies it, an interval spanning 0.80 is inconclusive, and operational qualification still requires every declared check.

implementer.reasoning: Approve as revised: S1 is an 80-episode stop point with a Wilson-overlap reproduction rule, the calibration grid is committed before S1, the residual integrates inside the pulse window, and every gate threshold is declared. Scope is directional tracking during rolling only; it establishes neither retention under nonzero residuals nor usefulness.
